rationale: The existing single-file React 18 CDN prototype is the immutable visual source of truth. The plan will preserve its UI and connect only the flows and feature areas represented by the current file, while documenting requested areas that are absent.

questions.question: Which language should the Boopa web app use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed React application code and safer Supabase integration.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Continue the prototype's JavaScript style with runtime typing only.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and build approach should be used while preserving the existing React UI?

options.label: React with Vite
options.description: A production React build that can migrate the CDN prototype incrementally.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify another compatible React setup in the freeform response.

questions.question: Which existing UI surfaces and requested behaviors must the frontend support?
questions.recommendedChoice: Preserve the existing CourseMate UI as Boopa; connect landing/auth signup, signin, password reset, profile creation/editing with avatar upload, Discover search/filters/self-exclusion, connections, messaging, present community and feed surfaces, and loading/error/empty states. Opportunities and marketplace remain out of scope unless discovered in the source UI.
questions.answer: Preserve the existing CourseMate UI as Boopa; connect landing/auth signup, signin, password reset, profile creation/editing with avatar upload, Discover search/filters/self-exclusion, connections, messaging, present community and feed surfaces, and loading/error/empty states. Opportunities and marketplace remain out of scope unless discovered in the source UI.

questions.question: Which language should backend integrations and any Supabase Edge Functions use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Shared types and Supabase Edge Functions using the supported Deno runtime.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript Edge Functions and client integration without static typing.

questions.question: Which backend approach should provide the application data boundary?
questions.recommendedChoice: Supabase Auth, PostgREST, Storage, Realtime, and Edge Functions where server-only logic is required
questions.answer: Supabase Auth, PostgREST, Storage, Realtime, and Edge Functions where server-only logic is required

options.label: Supabase platform services
options.description: Use Supabase-generated APIs, RLS, Storage, Realtime, and minimal Edge Functions instead of inventing a separate API server.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify an additional backend framework in the freeform response.

questions.question: Which backend capabilities must be implemented?
questions.recommendedChoice: Supabase Auth signup/signin/password reset, profiles and avatar Storage, Discover queries and filters, connection lifecycle, private messaging, community membership and feeds, posts/likes/comments only where represented by the UI, Realtime subscriptions where useful, migrations, RLS, and production environment configuration.
questions.answer: Supabase Auth signup/signin/password reset, profiles and avatar Storage, Discover queries and filters, connection lifecycle, private messaging, community membership and feeds, posts/likes/comments only where represented by the UI, Realtime subscriptions where useful, migrations, RLS, and production environment configuration.

sharedQuestions.question: Which data stores does Boopa require?

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Supabase database for profiles, connections, messages, communities, memberships, posts, reactions, and comments.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Supabase Storage for profile avatars and any media represented by the UI.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: No persistence, files, queues, or cache.

sharedQuestions.question: Should users sign in to access Boopa application features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require an authenticated account for profiles, discovery, connections, messaging, communities, and feed actions.

options.label: No
options.description: Keep application features publicly accessible without user accounts.
